This article introduces the general process and operation guidance for beginners to get started.

<span id="9cca5f57"></span>
# Product use general process


1. Administrator:

   * After purchasing and deploying the DataTester product, the group administrator needs to complete the previous operations such as member addition and role authorization.

   * Project administrators need to complete project creation, application access and other operations according to the plan before experimenters and developers operate.

      The administrator's hands\-on instructions can be seen [Quick Start: Administrator](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Quick-Start-Administrator).

2. Experimenter:

   * Experimenters need to understand the basic principles, application scenarios, design ideas, etc. of A/B testing before starting to plan and start A/B experiments. Please refer to the details [What is A/B Testing?](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/What-is-A-B-Testing).

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/fb7e6607e8104a7599a5b612d9a41981~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

      For example, according to the general pirate growth model, the diagram above depicts what day\-to\-day tasks an enterprise undertakes throughout the lifecycle of its users. From left to right, we describe some specific scenarios at each stage, from acquiring users to referrals. The top half mainly indicates the specific business activities carried out by the various roles of each department. The second half corresponds to the application scenario, which A/B experiments can be done.

   * The experimenter needs to plan the A/B experiment according to the business needs, make preparations before starting the experiment, and then start the A/B experiment according to the plan, check the results of the experiment report, and analyze the business development conclusions. Please see for details [Preparation for Experiments](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Preparation-for-Experiments).

3. Developer:

   1. Understand DataTester's data access capabilities and experimental streaming principles.

      <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

   2. According to the experimental plan, each end of the experiment needs to be collected for data access and configuration delivery operations, see the details [Quick Start: Research and Development](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Quick-Start-Research-and-Development).

4. Experimenter:

   1. Understand the key indicators of various types of experimental reports and the corresponding experimental results reports.

      
      |**Hypothesis Testing Reports: Traditional A/B Experiments** |**Bayesian\-based MAB Experiment Report: MAB Intelligent Tuning Experiment** |
      |---|---|
      |Based on the classic hypothesis testing framework and ByteDance's internal application and optimization for many years, an important module to ensure the scientificity of experiments is statistical reporting. DataTester provides statistical information such as P\-Value and confidence interval to help users identify the reliability of data. At the same time, it also provides some advanced statistical functions to correct statistical results, such as multiple comparison correction, sequential testing, etc., which can further improve the accuracy of statistical evaluation and help users make better judgments in some complex scenarios.<br><br><span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b5b74097d9bb40498d40ef72807137e9~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span><br><br>Click to view for details: [Experimental Report Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Experimental-Report-Overview). |MAB is a test tuning scheme based on Bayesian theory. The purpose of the experiment is to optimize the whole activity, not to find the optimal group. Therefore, DataTester provides a separate MAB experimental report.<br><br><span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/13a920b5ac0549d588515690850bd76f~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span><br><br>Click to view for details: [Overview of Intelligent Traffic Tuning (MAB) Reports](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Overview-of-Intelligent-Traffic-Tuning-MAB-Reports). |
      

   2. Start the A/B experiment on DataTester according to the plan, and view the result report of the corresponding experiment.
